title: Quarterly Statements, Final Accountings and the Resource-Limit Notice
content:
## Clause

For the Resident Trust Fund Accounts, a statement for each calendar quarter issues to the resident and representative within the statement days after the quarter ends, and a statement asked for in between is provided within the on-request business days. A final accounting issues when conveyance starts. A Medicaid resident is notified in writing when the account balance reaches the SSI resource limit less the notice margin, and told that a balance above the resource limit can end Medicaid eligibility; a further notice is sent only after the balance has fallen below that level and reached it again. Non-Medicaid tiers receive no resource notice.

## The notice level

The notice level is the SSI resource limit less the notice margin. A notice records the balance on the date it is sent.

## When a notice is sent (Medicaid tiers)

| Balance history since the last notice | Notice |
|---|---|
| no notice yet; balance reaches the notice level | sent |
| notice sent; balance stays at or above the level | none |
| notice sent; balance falls below the level, then reaches it again | sent |
| Non-Medicaid tier, any balance | none |

## Kinds of statement

| Statement | Issued |
|---|---|
| quarterly | for each calendar quarter, within the statement days after it ends |
| on request | within the on-request business days of the request |
| final accounting | when conveyance starts after a discharge or death |
